launches.title: Streamable 🔵 Never IRL Stream with Issues Again.
launches.tagline: Powering the biggest IRL streams today
launches.body:
# **TL;DR:**

Streamable makes sure many of the biggest IRL streams stay alive under poor network conditions.

# **The Main Problem:**

Without [Streamable.run](http://Streamable.run), streamers that stream outside and encounter poor network conditions, will disconnect from Twitch or Kick. Their stream will end, and their thousands of viewers get kicked from the stream. By the time they reconnect, most of their viewers have gone on to do something else.

Nang, being a streamer himself and being friends with many streamers, felt these issues firsthand and knew that all IRL streamers were frustrated with the current solutions available.

# **The Solution**

Cloud Hosted Streaming Servers. Our product sits in between the streamer and the streaming platform, which allows for a clean solution to many problems IRL Streamers face:

🔵 100% Stream Drop Protection: When a streamer encounters poor network conditions when streaming IRL, our system automatically switches their screen to display their most popular clips and let the viewers know that connection has been lost and that the streamer will be back soon. 

🔵 Remote Stream Management: Bigger streamers have remote teams that are not necessarily at the streaming location. The streaming server allows team members and moderators to edit and manage the stream from anywhere in the world.

🔵 Switch without ending stream: Without Streamable, streamers only have one input to their stream, causing them to need to end the stream in order to switch cameras (for example, switching from Desktop camera to IRL phone camera). With Streamable, they can switch cameras while livestreaming with a press of a button in our UI.

🔵 Collab Stream: Streaming platforms accept one input to the stream, making it impossible for streamers to share the same camera feed when collaborating. Streamable allows streamers to share inputs with other streamers with on-platform friend requests, so that all streamers can share the same camera easily.

# **Progress So Far:**

In the past 3 months, we’ve gotten a stable product that is the best on the market. We are also powering many of the biggest streamers and working with production teams for Adin Ross’ Brand Risk, Sperm Racing, FaZe Clan, EdwardKSo, etc. 

Through working with these streamers, we’ve discovered that the IRL streaming industry is growing extremely fast, has very underrated cultural relevance, and is currently extremely underserved. We believe streamers deserve so, so much better, and that’s what we’re here to do, starting with this first product!

# **ABOUT US:**

🔵 Nang Ang is a top Twitch streamer in the Software & Game Development category and has a B.S.&M.S @ CMU in Computer Engineering. He has been sharing his startup and entertiaing projects on Youtube and Twitch, and has grown a community of over 200k followers and 30 million total views on social media.

🔵 Manav Bokinala has built across infrastructure, AI, and consumer products — from co-founding an AI-powered app builder, to architecting distributed systems for an AI GTM platform, to shipping a consumer social app. He's now focused on solving the hardest problems in live streaming infrastructure.

# **Our Ask:**

If you IRL stream or know any IRL streamers - check Streamable out at <https://streamable.run>! We’re sure you’ll love it

# **More Links if you’re interested:**

Follow Streamable on X: <https://x.com/streamabledotrun>

Follow Streamable on Instagram: [https://instagram.com/streamabledotrun](https://x.com/streamabledotrun)

Join our Discord: <https://discord.gg/pb8ynsztYB>

**tl;dr -** [vly.ai](http://vly.ai) makes your entire team technical. We use expert insights & automation to deliver apps that grow faster & perform better, at 10x less cost.

<https://youtu.be/M4QcpDVFR2c>

# **Our ask:**

Share us ([www.vly.ai](https://www.vly.ai)) with people you know who need a custom web application (CRM, customer dashboard, etc)!

# **The Problem: Traditional web development is slow and expensive**

* Time-consuming with high hourly fees
* Hiring and maintaining a technical team is costly
* Long wait times for updates and launches
* Hard to deliver custom features quickly

# **Our Solution**

### Experts guide you through development, delivery, & growth

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXddUe6HBnTLfPh_Hylgm9XvCTeATPL2dVc0Y6w_vAMZzWKMuk3nwVLenxnU0vubXyNOy5CaCO1lLF-NfmcGlhnh_HAEHHrpjiE-UDDccTz7s6oVEJUWp56ZnDdeZolEFaCRIytQCQ?key=Rofjj3L0nHor8aOdKiEi1VVm)

While typical tools provide no guarantees on solving your issues, we sit down with you to ensure your vision is delivered. Our industry knowledge provides you with a significant advantage over competitors taking on the risk.

### End-to-end automation of the dev process, verified & tested by humans

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdV4fwJz5dYAaB0in3xe9vz8fKvNSeImjxjYvpgRSvDJyIEDpRLh3piPSHifLjxhvE4HMKSdyU8sxNd9ce20lA0bXsv0PUx93NFri0p5EH498-i_O_VRgmrv5HCTD1jU_uRnHZdMg?key=Rofjj3L0nHor8aOdKiEi1VVm)

We use a series of LLM agents to do the heavy lifting of the development process, to ensure your product is delivered faster & reliably. Our experts also review & test the results alongside you.

### A no-code platform to visually understand your application

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeC4D_XnRcW4V8fWfeRSGxPePWD9cr02esFFuTmxcFNntnneaQWauOaRd310Ct8rin9PAnoEb25CAc9rs_wemeLX9IScwecPtFshELeTy1A373G03vNU2U1VfXE9wf-PkNwi0PeTg?key=Rofjj3L0nHor8aOdKiEi1VVm)

We go beyond solely writing pure code by building a visual representation of your entire project context, allowing you to easily scale the complexity of your application.

### A point-&-click tool to make changes instantly

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85406&key=user_uploads/1357897/0d4ea8a6-c777-49f1-819a-f5ba0ad40821)

We provide an effortless way for people who can’t code to make simple changes quickly. Not a broad back-and-forth chat, but a very simple “click and describe” interface to let you get specific about what you want.

# **The Result**

Effortlessly ship your product and iterate on new features, at 90% faster speeds and 10x lower costs.

# **Why are we solving this problem?**

[Victor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/victor-cheng-89a161180/), [Manav](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mbokinala/), and [Amir](https://www.linkedin.com/in/theamirfarahani/) came together to build [vly.ai](http://vly.ai) after exiting their own software companies, and needing a solution to launch more at a faster pace. [vly.ai](http://vly.ai) was born to create production-ready software products at breakneck speed.

# FAQ

\*\*What if we have an existing system?\*\*\
We can integrate with your database and backend API!

\*\*Is this for internal tools or customer-facing products?\*\*\
We build both consumer-facing tools as well as internal dashboards & automations

\*\*What if I don’t want to spend time learning & integrating a new system?\*\*\
That’s the magic; we set it up for you, and if you ever need to make changes, you just need to point & click through our no-code platform.

We’re not just a tool; we’re a service that will ensure that you will never have to worry about web software again.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeafSaZqx06izRuiDnZLPPdwABcwrt0xdcL_thyQ1ja-cDKGHlu20JTcwLsvC0TKQ4DDMzlOMJWfLdtNmIOYdFKVE4Qmzo90PnmsXvVYNjg1DwyQtYT4HlFYZBlVfTGtjQMJjlHDA?key=Rofjj3L0nHor8aOdKiEi1VVm)
